newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE ends near lows on weak Dow, rates gloom.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE ends near lows on weak Dow, rates gloom.

text.p: A weak opening on Wall Street and worries about higher U.S. and UK interest rates dragged the UK stock market down on Wednesday.
The FTSE 100 share index closed a lacklustre trading session 16.6 points lower at 3,955.7, just off the day's lows. The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down eight points at the time.
Losers outnumbered gainers more than two to one in moderate volume of just over 516 million shares traded.
Dealers said the market, which early this week had looked set to smash through the psychologically-important 4,000 level, stalled on a fractious debate over U.S. and UK rates policy.
